name: The Langham Jakarta
positioning: Luxury hotel in Jakarta's Sudirman Central Business District, the first Langham in Southeast Asia (official name The Langham, Jakarta)
best_for: Travelers who want a business-district base with a rooftop bar and a spa
Guests who like arranged cultural outings such as batik and the old town

facts.text: The hotel is in Jakarta's Sudirman Central Business District.
Guests of Executive Rooms and Suites have access to The Langham Club.
The Langham Club offers private check-ins, refreshments and a workspace for private meetings.
Chuan Spa uses Biologique Recherche products for facials.
The hotel has an infinity outdoor swimming pool.
The concierge can arrange a hands-on batik workshop where guests learn wax-dyeing techniques with artisans.
Guests can have an alfresco candlelit dinner at Hampton Garden.
Private yoga sessions are offered in Hampton Garden.

highlights.text: It is the first Langham hotel in Southeast Asia.
The hotel was designed by SRSS, Wilson Associates and Avroko.
The hotel has a rooftop bar with views of the Jakarta skyline.
The Presidential Suite offers personal butler service.
The hotel offers a Kota Tua Batavia old town outing that includes the Jakarta History Museum and a Wayang workshop.

considerations.text: The hotel sits in a central business district, so the setting is urban rather than a resort.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy urban area with city traffic.
Cultural and outdoor excursions are arranged and booked through the Concierge team.
